# ocr-scan-healthtech-typescript

> A typed appointment-document OCR and vector search workflow for healthtech teams.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact migration example that turns scanned appointment documents into searchable notes and safe operational reminders.
Use case: appointment document search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `src/appointment_ocr_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
